test_cases.objective: Verify that checksums of extracted legacy data match the transformed and loaded data in the cloud platform.

test_steps.action: Generate checksums for all legacy data files before extraction.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksums are successfully generated and documented.

test_steps.action: Extract legacy data and verify checksums post-extraction.
test_steps.expected_result: Extracted data checksums match pre-extraction checksums.

test_steps.action: Transform and load data into the cloud platform and generate new checksums.
test_steps.expected_result: Data is successfully loaded and checksums are generated.

test_steps.action: Compare pre-extraction and post-load checksums.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksums match, confirming data integrity.

acceptance_criteria: All checksums must match between legacy and migrated data.
No data corruption or loss detected during migration.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure no data alteration during migration
